hints: For each array segment, store its total sum and best subarray sum.
The best subarray in a joined interval is either fully left, fully right, or crosses the split.
A crossing subarray is the best suffix of the left plus the best prefix of the right.
analogy: When two halves join, the winning segment stays in one half or crosses their border.
example: For [−2,3] and [−1,4], a crossing candidate is suffix 3 plus prefix 3, total 6.
algorithm: Build a segment tree storing sum, bestPrefix, bestSuffix, and bestSubarray. Merge with best=max(left.best,right.best,left.suffix+right.prefix); after each point update print the root best.
correctness: Every subarray lies wholly in one child or crosses the split; the stored suffix/prefix make the best crossing candidate available.
complexity: O(n) build, O(log n) per update, O(n) space.
